How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
We typically ship orders within 1 to 2 business days of placement.
Once your order is processed and picked up in the afternoon, tracking details are updated and sent out. Standard transit then takes about 1 to 5 business days depending on your distance from our warehouse in Minnesota.
If you'd like us to look up the exact status of your shipment, just share your order number and email address!
